description: DLR Highway Traffic dataset (DLR HT) is a dataset listed in German national open data portal (GovData), an open data portal, published or maintained by Mobilithek. The dataset includes both raw and metadata from the Test Bed Lower Saxony in Braunschweig, Germany. The raw data comprises trajectory data of traffic participants, along with current local weather data, and road condition data. Coverage: Mobilithek. The portal files it under the publisher Mobilithek. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-de-portal.
